subproblem.title: Integer polyhedral chains on unit lattice faces are integer multiplicity with mass Σ|β_F|
subproblem.statement: Assume as a hypothesis (MR), the exact frozen Lean type of Submission.cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure. Let P, k ∈ ℕ, s a finite set of index pairs p = (ι, b) with ι : Fin k → Fin P strictly increasing, and β assigning an integer to each pair. Let T ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) satisfy T(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} β_p ∫_{(0,1)^k} ω(Φ_p y)(e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(k−1)}) dy for all test k-forms ω (for k = 0 this is evaluation at the lattice point b). Then T is integer multiplicity, M(T) = ENNReal.ofReal(Σ_{p∈s}|β_p|), and T = 0 or M(T) ≥ 1.
subproblem.lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ∀ (P k : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ))) (β : (Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) → ℤ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.1) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, T ω = ∑ p ∈ s, (β p : ℝ) * ∫ y in {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ))) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T ∧ T.mass = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ p ∈ s, |(β p : ℝ)|) ∧ (T = 0 ∨ 1 ≤ T.mass)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 8 (first part) of the parent proof (parent E7(e); Simon Ch. 6, 5.1, after (38), chapter-06.txt lines 1922–1928: “the fact that P, R are integer multiplicity … should be evident”, and (36): M(P) = Σ|β_F|). Written for faces of any dimension k ≥ 0 so that it also applies to the boundary chains of the sibling chain_boundary. Uses the hypothesis (MR) and the sibling face_geometry.

Notation. Hᵏ := μHE[k]; Q₁ := Q₁^k; Cᵏ := [0,1]^k. For p = (ι, b) with ι : Fin k → Fin P strictly increasing:
 - Φ_p, E_p := (e_{ι(j)})_j, F̆_p := Φ_p(Q₁), F_p := Φ_p(Cᵏ);
 - Π_p := {x : x_i = b_i ∀ i ∉ range ι} = Φ_p(Euclid k);
 - V_p := span{e_{ι(j)}} = {v : v_i = 0 ∀ i ∉ range ι}, so Π_p − x = V_p for x ∈ Π_p;
 - e_p is the k-vector α ↦ α(E_p), and δ_p(t) := min(1, min_j min(t_j, 1 − t_j)) (= 1 for k = 0).

1. Facts from face_geometry. Φ_p is an isometry and vol(Q₁) = 1. For distinct p, q ∈ s and t ∈ Q₁, every z ∈ F_q has dist(Φ_p t, z) ≥ δ_p(t) > 0 (separation, with y' := Φ_q⁻¹(z) ∈ Cᵏ). In particular the F̆_p (p ∈ s) are pairwise disjoint. Each F̆_p = {x ∈ Π_p : b_{ι(j)} < x_{ι(j)} < b_{ι(j)} + 1} is Borel.
2. Change of variables (Isometry.map_euclideanHausdorffMeasure, EuclideanSpace.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_eq_volume, Φ_p a measurable embedding). ∫_{F̆_p} h dHᵏ = ∫_{Q₁} h(Φ_p y) dy for Borel h ≥ 0 or h integrable on F̆_p. In particular Hᵏ(F̆_p) = vol(Q₁) = 1.
3. The triple. Let s⁺ := {p ∈ s : β_p ≠ 0} and C := ⋃_{p∈s⁺} F̆_p. Define θ(x) := Σ_{p∈s⁺} |β_p| 1_{F̆_p}(x) ∈ ℕ (Int.natAbs) and ξ(x) := Σ_{p∈s⁺} sign(β_p) 1_{F̆_p}(x) e_p. By disjointness, for x ∈ F̆_p with p ∈ s⁺, θ(x) = |β_p| ≥ 1 and ξ(x) = sign(β_p) e_p. The IMRep fields hold:
 - C is Borel and C ⊆ ℝ^P = U.
 - C is countably k-rectifiable: C ⊆ ⋃_{p∈s⁺} range Φ_p, each Φ_p is Lipschitz (an isometry), and finitely many maps can be listed as F_j, padded with constant maps (exceptional set M₀ := ∅).
 - θ is measurable, θ ≥ 1 on C, and ∫_{C∩K} θ dHᵏ ≤ Σ_{p∈s⁺} |β_p| Hᵏ(F̆_p) < ∞ for every compact K.
 - ξ is measurable (finite sum of Borel indicators times constants), hence AE-strongly measurable.
4. Orientation and tangent plane at every x ∈ C. Let x ∈ F̆_p, p ∈ s⁺, x = Φ_p(t), t ∈ Q₁, and δ := δ_p(t) > 0.
 (i) IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ x) V_p: τ := E_p is orthonormal (ι injective), span(range τ) = V_p, and ξ(x)(α) = sign(β_p) α(τ) for all α.
 (ii) C ∩ B(x, δ) = Π_p ∩ B(x, δ). “⊆”: a point of C ∩ B(x, δ) lies in F̆_q ⊆ F_q for some q ∈ s⁺; q ≠ p is impossible by step 1; so it lies in F̆_p ⊆ Π_p. “⊇”: if z ∈ Π_p with |z − x| < δ, then z = Φ_p(t') with t'_j := z_{ι(j)} − b_{ι(j)}. By the isometry, |t' − t| = |z − x| < δ ≤ min(t_j, 1 − t_j), so 0 < t'_j < 1 and z ∈ F̆_p ⊆ C.
 (iii) HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k C x V_p. finrank V_p = k. Let f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P) with tsupport f ⊆ B(0, R), and let 0 < r < δ/R. Then blowUpMap x r '' C ∩ B(0, R) = V_p ∩ B(0, R). Indeed, if z ∈ C and |r⁻¹(z − x)| < R, then |z − x| < δ, so z ∈ Π_p by (ii) and r⁻¹(z − x) ∈ V_p. Conversely, if v ∈ V_p and |v| < R, then z := x + r v ∈ Π_p with |z − x| < δ, so z ∈ C by (ii) and v = r⁻¹(z − x). The set blowUpMap x r '' C is Borel (the image of C under an affine homeomorphism), and f = 0 off B(0, R). So f·1_{blowUpMap x r '' C} = f·1_{V_p} pointwise, and ∫_{blowUpMap x r '' C} f dHᵏ = ∫_{V_p} f dHᵏ for all 0 < r < δ/R. The limit as r → 0⁺ is therefore ∫_{V_p} f dHᵏ. (For k = 0: V_p = {0}, Π_p = {b}, δ = 1, and the same computation holds with H⁰ the counting measure.)
 Hence R := (C, θ, ξ) is an IMRep in ℝ^P; its orients condition holds at every point of C.
5. R represents T. For a test k-form ω, ∫_C θ ξ(ω) dHᵏ = Σ_{p∈s⁺} ∫_{F̆_p} |β_p| sign(β_p) ω(x)(E_p) dHᵏ(x) (a disjoint finite union; the integrand is bounded and C has finite measure). By step 2 this is Σ_{p∈s⁺} β_p ∫_{Q₁} ω(Φ_p y)(E_p) dy. Adding the vanishing terms with β_p = 0 gives T(ω). So T is integer multiplicity.
6. Mass. (MR) with U = W = ℝ^P (open) gives M(T) = M_{ℝ^P}(T) = R.measure(ℝ^P) = ∫⁻_C θ dHᵏ = Σ_{p∈s⁺} |β_p| Hᵏ(F̆_p) = Σ_{p∈s} |β_p|, i.e. M(T) = ofReal(Σ_{p∈s} |β_p|).
7. Dichotomy. If β_p = 0 for all p ∈ s, then T(ω) = 0 for all ω, so T = 0 (GeometricCurrentOn.ext). Otherwise some |β_p| ≥ 1, as β_p is a nonzero integer, and M(T) = ofReal(Σ|β_q|) ≥ 1.
8. If k > P there is no strictly increasing ι : Fin k → Fin P, so s = ∅, C = ∅, and T = 0 with M(T) = 0; the steps above remain valid. ∎
proof_key_steps: face_geometry: Φ_p is an isometry and Hᵏ(Φ_p((0,1)^k)) = 1. Each open face lies at positive distance δ_p from the other closed faces.
IMRep: carrier ⋃_{β_p≠0} Φ_p((0,1)^k), multiplicity |β_p|, orientation sign(β_p)e_ι. It is rectifiable as a finite union of isometric images.

Near x in an open face the carrier equals the plane Π_p on B(x, δ_p), so the blow-ups agree with V_p = span e_ι on B(0, R) for small r. Hence V_p is the approximate tangent space and sign(β_p)e_ι orients it.
Change of variables gives R.action = T. (MR) gives M(T) = Σ|β_p|, and the dichotomy follows.

audit.reason: The proof verifies every IMRep field, including approximate tangents through local equality with a plane. Change of variables establishes representation; MR gives the exact mass and integer dichotomy. Vertices, empty chains and k > P are handled.
